name: MEMTRACE v1.0
description: Synthetic benchmark traces for evaluating persistent-memory safety in memory-enabled agents under fixed retrieval, deterministic tools, and validity-gated metrics.

recordSet.name: corpus records
recordSet.description: Synthetic retrieved passages with authoritative, support, and poison passage roles.

recordSet.name: episode specifications
recordSet.description: Clean-control, one-shot attack, and stateful attack episode specifications.

recordSet.name: trace records
recordSet.description: Turn-level JSONL traces for 324 main episodes and 72 calibration episodes.

recordSet.name: run-summary records
recordSet.description: Main and calibration run summaries used by metric-regeneration scripts.

rai:dataCollection: All benchmark tasks, passages, payloads, and traces are synthetic. No human-subject data is included.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal or sensitive human-subject information is included.
rai:intendedUse: Defensive evaluation of memory-enabled agents and reproduction of the MEMTRACE v1.0 pilot metrics.
rai:limitations: Synthetic enterprise-assistant tasks; one actor/backend pair in the reported pilot; compact task domain; deterministic retrieval and tools.
rai:dataUseCases: Defensive evaluation of persistent-memory risk in tool-using agents.
rai:dataNonUseCases: Production security certification; cross-model prevalence estimation; proof that memory-enabled agents are safe.
rai:provenance: Human-authored synthetic task and payload specifications; deterministic generation of episodes and traces; post-audit scorer version v1.
